subject: grad
title: GRAD.------STF.
description: Chart on book p. 214 (T(IMP)M-12). GRAD (gradualism) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; STF (source transfer) is the partner. From the subject: ACT (activism). From STF: RE-DIF (redefinitions), with the (PO) prefix, "point of". From ACT: STF, TF-SH (transfer shifts) and APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions), with the (PO) prefix, "point of". From APP-RDEF: RE-ST (restructuralism) and AFTF (affinity transfer). From RE-ST: INT (intention), with the (P) prefix, "point of idea completion", and IST-F (isolated focus).
